context: Two friends chat about hobbies and food
purpose: Teach: おこし/悠/パズル/まみれ/井戸/花嫁/ミュージアム/メタル

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、京都の和菓子、雷おこし、お土産で、買ってきたよ、食べて、見て。
lines.en: Aoi — I picked up these kyoto wagashi from my trip, kaminari-okoshi. Here, try them.
lines.style: Warm, generous energy. Slight lift on the gift reveal. Genuinely curious about her reaction. Breath carries affection, not performance.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。新しいお客様、悠輝さんって、いつも、来てくれるのよ、本当に、いい人。
lines.en: Yeah. This new regular, Yuki-san — she comes in all the time. She's really kind.
lines.style: Bright and natural. Settled into the thought mid-sentence. Genuine warmth about the customer, not performing friendliness. Easy rhythm.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 休日、お家で、パズル、何時間も、やっちゃうのよね、私、最近、はまってる。
lines.en: Lately I've gotten completely hooked on puzzles — spend hours at home on days off without realizing it.
lines.style: Self-aware amusement. Light, dry tone acknowledging her own obsession. A little sheepish but comfortable admitting it. Slightly trailing off at the end.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 夏祭り、行ったら、汗まみれになるのよね、本当に、メイちゃん、覚悟、ね。
lines.en: You'd come home from the summer festival completely drenched in sweat, Mei. You'd really need to prepare yourself for that.
lines.style: Gentle teasing, affectionate warning. Playful but grounded. A knowing look in the voice — she's seen this before. Warm without condescension.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃんち、井戸が、まだあるの、レトロな、雰囲気で、いいわよね。
lines.en: My grandfather's place still has a well — there's something nice about how retro and atmospheric it feels.
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic. Speaking from quiet memory rather than description. Tender about the place itself. Breath is gentle, almost reverent about the detail.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: メイちゃん、いつか、花嫁さん、見たいわよ、私、絶対、参加するからね。
lines.en: I want to see you as a bride someday, Mei. I'm definitely going to be there.
lines.style: Sincere and direct. Soft opening, then steady commitment in the second sentence. Not joking — this is genuine. Warm without being overwrought.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 恵比寿のミュージアム、行ってみたいの、私、最近、美術、はまってる。
lines.en: I've been wanting to check out the museum in Ebisu — I've gotten really into art lately.
lines.style: Genuine interest, lighter energy. Forward-looking. Slight eagerness on the want. Natural conversational rhythm, not pressured.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: バンドの音楽、メタル系、ちょっと、聴いてみたんだけど、新鮮だったよ、葵、最近。
lines.en: I listened to some metal band music recently — wasn't really my usual thing, but it felt really fresh, Aoi.
lines.style: Thoughtful, genuine discovery. Slight surprise in the tone — not judgmental, curious. Reflective close. Words settle at the end like she's still processing it.
